These actions align with the HLG's description of enabling service providers to publish, categorize, manage their services with detailed information, pricing, and availability.

The LLGs are supported by documentary evidence in the source description, covering all essential aspects of managing service offerings without redundancy or omission. Each LLG represents a unique, automatic effect that does not require manual triggering by the Service Provider actor, adhering to the specified criteria for LLGs.
